text_block_list.text:
Today is the Tenno Sho (Autumn). To 
prepare for this grand stage, Gold Ship 
brought out her secret weapon.

What's inside is a sea urchin stuffed with 
chestnut burrs— a triple threat of pure 
pain! Now go out there and Golshi-kick 
your rivals into next week!☆

Naturally, it was confiscated by the 
Trainer as hazardous material, and she was 
to battle Tosen Jordan fairly and squarely 
in the race. Safe!
